scope: Functional port of defensive equipment wear and the World return of lifedrain/reflection; not certification of Gameforge balance or full server parity.

pinned_skill_catalogue.limitation: The pinned catalogue does not establish server-side equipment wear probability or which item options should trigger skills.

implementation_references.rule: After CalcDamage and before OnDamage: block wears selector 4, otherwise positive HP damage wears selector 3. CanFight gates the rolled reaction. Damage modifier uses incoming level and sequential DAMAGE/HP deltas; mirror forwards HP damage through MW_GETBLOOD; remaining reaction is sent as wBackSkill.
Selector 3 chooses head/body/pants/hand/foot/back; selector 4 selects the secondary shield.
Inherited 0..2 durability roll and option-ID order with raw stored value as the proc threshold. These probabilities need independent publisher verification.
The defender's client launches the announced item counter-skill at level 1 against the attacker.
Authenticate main char/key, resolve player/monster/own summon, reject dead objects, cap HP/MP gain, reflected damage leaves at least 1 HP.
Route to the PC attacker's main or to the non-PC attacker's host main.

live_sql_inspection.query: SELECT bMagic,wAutoSkill FROM TITEMMAGICCHART WHERE wAutoSkill <> 0 ORDER BY bMagic
live_sql_inspection.limitation: No option-to-skill assignments were inferred or invented. Reactive branches are exercised with isolated test templates; whether Gameforge requires different content assignments remains unverified.

validation.platform: Isolated Linux .NET 10 SDK container; source and host NuGet cache mounted read-only
